verdict.rationale: Disclosure of renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms is a fair question for a registered-agent and entity-compliance service, so the axis applies. However, the pack holds only two robots.txt probes: the main Wolters Kluwer host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy CT host redirects into that walled host. No CT Corporation pricing, renewal, cancellation or transfer-out content was retrieved, so there is no evidence the terms are documented.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms are documented, so leaving the service does not strand the entity
